description: This file contains unit tests for the EnforcerRetriever class, implementing tests to verify proper exception handling and cache retrieval behavior in the enforcement service of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: EnforcerRetrieverTest
classes.description: Test suite for EnforcerRetriever, testing cache retrieval and exception propagation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EnforcerRetriever instance with mocked caches before each test.

methods.name: verifyLookupRevealsInnerException
methods.description: Verifies that exceptions thrown during cache lookup are correctly propagated.

methods.name: verifyLookupRevealsInnermostException
methods.description: Ensures that the innermost exceptions in nested cache lookups are properly propagated.

methods.name: verifyLookupEnforcerRevealsException
methods.description: Tests that exceptions during enforcer cache retrieval are correctly propagated.

methods.name: verifyException
methods.description: Helper method to assert that the completion stage completes exceptionally with the expected exception.
